From Sidewalk to Seating, excellent but smoky
Mar 2024 • Friends
I Remember the two guys from when they were standing on the sidewalk. 

Now they've moved into a more restaurant-like setup. The food is still good value for money and fast, but the seats are perhaps a bit rustic and low. The gravel doesn't help much with that; it's a bit hard on my long legs.

One easy improvement that would make this a 5 out of 5 

Install a suction fan in the kitchen. Perhaps you have one, but it's not on? Or it's missing. The smoke from the kitchen makes most seats a bad pick and is clearly an issue. Fans are $50; have one installed to improve airflow out the side. It's a 10-minute job. Guys, please, please sort this out

Good standard Italian fare
Dec 2020 • Family

The lingiune was very good but I felt the meatball could be better infused with the tomato sauce. The pizza too was good and did not disappoint. Last but not the least was chocolate digestif was much appreciated. Am coming back.

Great Authentic Italian
Jan 2020 • Couples
We just enjoyed a nice lunch at Pasta Fresca. We started with a margarita pizza followed by salad and pasta. And, of course, we had some nice Italian wine to accompany our meal. All of the food was delicious; nice fresh ingredients. The service was very good, efficient and friendly. The setting was nice and cosy too; lots of fans blowing to keep us comfortable. We had a brief chat with the owner (originally from Tuscany area) who was very nice. Overall, it was a very nice experience. I’d definitely recommend this restaurant.

Little hidden gem!
Aug 2019 • Couples
So grateful to have finally found a place which serves authentic Italian food at a fair price not making it fancy like most of the Italian restaurants in Saigon. 
That’s the way we do it in Italy! 
The pasta is always on point and cooked al dente like it should be and sauces are fresh and tasty. 
Appetizers and desserts are also delicious! 
Love the tiramisù and the chocolate tart!
The place has great vibes and the staff are always very nice and welcoming. 
Keep up the good work!

More choices of pasta - small dinning place.
Jan 2019 • Friends
The restaurant is quite small with a few tables. A bit feels like a bar in the garden. The soil is with pebbles and wood panels so it’s not high heels friendly. Recommend going here it’s much easy without heels.

I ordered Gorgonzola salad & balsamic salad, eggplant parmigiana and green spinach linguine with Gorgonzola with balsamic reduction. 
The salad is normal.

The eggplant parmigiana that I ate in the other place some times ago and I love it very much. So I was a bit excited to order and eat here. But when staff brought it to me. It was contained in one pot with room temperature. So the eggplant parmigiana was a bit cool down. It doesn’t taste as good as I ate before in other restaurant while eggplant parmigiana and the pot is baked in the oven.

The spinach linguine with Gorgonzola is really good. Balsamic reduction is separated. It’s very thick sauce and it tastes a bit sweet.
